description: PILOT-034 Enterprise Pilot Readiness Matrix — advisory-only, no autonomous promotion. Tracks matrix runs, gate evaluations, required gate status, and dimension breakdown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT matrix_run_id, tenant_id, status, ROUND(matrix_score * 100, 1) AS score_pct, gates_passed, gates_warned, gates_failed, required_gates_pass, finalized_at FROM pilot_readiness_matrix_runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT ROUND(matrix_score * 100, 0) AS score_bucket FROM pilot_readiness_matrix_runs WHERE status IN ('passed', 'failed') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT required_gates_pass::text AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM pilot_readiness_matrix_runs GROUP BY required_gates_pass
SELECT dimension AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM pilot_readiness_gate_evaluations WHERE $__timeFilter(evaluated_at) GROUP BY dimension ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT status AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM pilot_readiness_gate_evaluations WHERE $__timeFilter(evaluated_at) GROUP BY status

SELECT e.evaluated_at AS time, e.gate_id AS metric, 1 AS value FROM pilot_readiness_gate_evaluations e WHERE e.gate_id IN ('soak_validation','replay_verification','tenant_isolation','rollback_readiness') AND e.status = 'fail' AND $__timeFilter(e.evaluated_at) ORDER BY time
SELECT source_type AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM pilot_readiness_evidence_links WHERE $__timeFilter(linked_at) GROUP BY source_type ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

options.content: **Advisory Only — PILOT-034** | All matrix assessments are informational. No autonomous promotion is triggered. SELF_APPROVE_BLOCKED enforced. Operator review required for all go/no-go decisions.

title: XDR Pilot Readiness Matrix — PILOT-034
